name: qlrisk_price_cross_currency_basis_swap
title: Price a CrossCurrencyBasisSwap
description:
Price one Cross-Currency Basis Swap (qlrisk CrossCurrencyBasisSwap): NPV, pricing components and Greeks where the pricer gives them.
Inputs (* required): maturity* (tenor like 3Y or date), notional (amount; default 1000000), frequency (annual/semi-annual/quarterly/monthly/at maturity; default semi-annual), pair (default EURUSD), foreign_curve (default ESTR), domestic_coupon_pct (percent, 3 = 3%), foreign_coupon_pct (percent, 3 = 3%), foreign_notional, currency (see the schema's list; default USD). Rates are in percent, spreads in basis points, maturities a tenor (3Y, 18M, 6W, 10D) or a date YYYY-MM-DD. Optional `advanced`: trade_id, trade_date, effective_date, counterparty_id, position, market_data, reporting_currency, include_cash_flows; market data defaults to qlrisk's sample snapshot valued today.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "notional": 1000000} gives NPV -1,006.80 USD on the sample market valued 2026-10-09. For several trades at once use qlrisk_price_trades.
